name: Micronaut Core 5.2.2
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Register the physical signature of Kotlin suspend functions in the Graal reflection config by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13133
* Answer 400 when a Publisher<CompletedFileUpload> part has no file name by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13124
### Improvements ⭐
* Resolve the built-in body handlers' types once by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13139
* Reduce cold startup work: no zip file system scans, lazy MediaType quality, no Loom probe by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13121
* Look up optional netty types by name in the access log connection metadata by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13120
* Only devolve the streams read in the current batch at read complete by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13148
* Keep the open WebSocket sessions next to the channel group by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13143
* Record per pipeline whether the access log handler is installed by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13142
* Make the HTTP/2 connection receive window configurable by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13140
### Docs 📖
* Document where request event listeners run and report slow ones by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13146
### Other Changes 💡
* HTTP/2 specification conformance and h2c pipeline wiring by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13100
* Netty server pipeline configuration fixes by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13101
* Tidy up response and request lifecycle handling in PipeliningServerHandler by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13102
* Four small correctness fixes in the HTTP server, Netty layer and form binding by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13104
* Netty server bootstrap and shutdown fixes by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13107
* Cache parsed Accept header media type lists by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13108
* Add JMH benchmarks for multipart, form, chunked and streaming JSON server scenarios by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13112
* Do not retain lazy proxy targets as dependents of the proxy's context by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13131
* Fix/12749 Jackson exception handling in core processor by @samikshathorat21 in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13172
* Handle absent optional HTTP/2 client configuration by @dlwhdgus0810 in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13092
* Let a refresh read the catalog it is rebuilding by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13168
* Report annotation member defaults for Kotlin, Groovy and Python as for Java by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13160
* Preserve annotation occurrence semantics in EvaluatedAnnotationMetadata by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13173
* Answer a non-repeatable annotation from the annotation values by name by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13166
* Describe a java.lang.reflect.Proxy through the interfaces it stands for by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13175
* Add BeanConstructor.getTargetConstructor() and cache ExecutableMethod.getTargetMethod() by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13156
* Read @Introspected.Property on the most derived declaration, for a proxy as for a class by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13181
* Synthesize annotations of package private types by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13174
* Fix duplicate Kotlin collection introspection properties by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13144
* Bind the type arguments of super types two or more levels up through each level by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13138
* Bind Python transitive supertype arguments by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13149
* Release buffered HTTP/2 request data when the stream closes before read complete by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13182
* Instantiate beans with a private injected constructor reflectively by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13136
* Resolve Python compiler error dump directory lazily by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13184
* Make StreamPressureSpec independent of the reader thread by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13186
* Cache the Date header and access log timestamp per second; clear the access log request attribute by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13118

## New Contributors
* @dlwhdgus0810 made their first contribution in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13092

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.1...v5.2.2
